result.approvedSubtitle: For six thousand years llamas stood on hills and looked unimpressed. Humans took this for attitude. It was attitude. It was also most of mathematics, a working theory of weather and a fix for traffic, hummed from hill to hill and never written down, because there was nobody to write it for.
